NATO allies announce billions in defense deals amid Trump's comments

NATO allies have announced significant investments in defense capabilities, including billions for new missile and anti-drone projects, during a summit in Ankara. Discussions also involved U.S. President Donald Trump's stance on alliances and his comments regarding Iran and Greenland. The summit highlighted both increased defense spending and ongoing diplomatic discussions among member nations.
